pr_comments: Can you not collapse by the reviewee-self other than 'Suggested changes'? Reviewers cannot see what you say or how you respond.
Would it be better to have "Group by month" be its own option instead of making it a sub option of "Group by date"?

> Would it be better to have "Group by month" be its own option instead of making it a sub option of "Group by date"?

I think so. There are several "Group by date" options, so it would be cleaner to add one sub option than to add monthly groupings to all of them.
That's true, but it's still confusing to have the sub options the way they are. While I dislike nesting multiple sub menus, I think it's the best option here.

> While I dislike nesting multiple sub menus, I think it's the best option here.

If the submenus are nested, we have to open the nested submenus to see what they are grouped by. I think it is inconvenient.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/66369541/236666406-3c8c5a3a-006d-4afb-9f95-549fb26070a8.png)

> If the submenus are nested, we have to open the nested submenus to see what they are grouped by. I think it is inconvenient.

True, you don't see which one is selected without opening the menu but at least the options are grouped together. It's not apparent that the options go together if they aren't next to each other.
I changed "Group by year" and "Group by month" to sub options of "Group by date".

issue_context.title: Feature: Add support to group by month
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

Hello, I have been looking for a file explorer that can sort folders into groups by a specific date, and through my research, I went across your app and obtained it through the windows store. 

I see that it can group the folder by years compared to Native Explorer's "A long time ago". 
Which is slightly better than the native ones, but I'd need more than this. 

I'd like it to sort all files/folders by month. even for older files/folders that were created a year ago. 



### Requirements

To have the file sorted by specific month.

i.e.: Assuming May. 
last week
earlier month 
last month
April 2023
March 2023 
February 2023
....

Dec 2022
Nov 2022

Etc

### Files Version

v2.4.70

### Windows Version

22621.1635

### Comments

_No response_
comments:
> Something like `Group by month`?

Yes, I would like to track file modification/creation by specific month.

> I'll work on this.

Much appreciated
This will be added in v2.5.
